channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Channel Street (open space) (Mission Rock), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Added · Channel Street (open space): Added a record for Channel Street (open space).
item.description: Added a record for Channel Street (open space). Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-07/Mission%20Rock%20Design%20Controls%204.24.18_FINAL_Reduced%20File.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Channel Street (open space): The record's notes and its earlier change entry said the 2019 Phase 1 submittal delivered an interim plaza here, that the permanent design comes with Block C, and that satellite imagery shows paving and planting today. The 2019 submittal is only a plan and does not say which lot any interim plaza is; nothing read ties Channel Street to Block C; and no imagery source was cited. Those claims are removed and the notes say the lot's current condition is not confirmed; status stays planned. The June 2026 Phase 2 milestone that named Channel Street and Block C was removed from this record because the Port memo never mentions either. The Jan 30, 2018 Design Controls approval milestone no longer calls the space an interim plaza and now cites the Sept 2019 Port memo that states the date.

item.title: Added · Channel Street (open space): Channel Street added on its real lot: the planned open space between Blocks B and C. The 2019 Phase 1 submittal planned interim treatments for Channel Street; what was built on the lot is not confirmed. (An earlier version of this entry said it was an interim plaza today, which no source supports.)

item.title: Planned · Channel Street (open space): Port Commission approves the Mission Rock Design Controls, which define the planned Channel Street open space (Design Controls Section 3.7); the Port's Jan 26, 2018 staff report requested this approval under Resolution 18-04, and its Sept 2019 memo dates the Commission's approvals January 30, 2018 (it numbers the Design Controls resolution 18-05) (Jan 30, 2018)
item.description: Port Commission approves the Mission Rock Design Controls, which define the planned Channel Street open space (Design Controls Section 3.7); the Port's Jan 26, 2018 staff report requested this approval under Resolution 18-04, and its Sept 2019 memo dates the Commission's approvals January 30, 2018 (it numbers the Design Controls resolution 18-05) (Jan 30, 2018). Source: Port Commission Item 11A staff report, Jan 26 2018 (request); Port Commission Item 7A memo, Sept 20 2019 (approval date).
